segments.an3.62:1.1: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:1.3: Hoti so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho vuṭṭhāti.
segments.an3.62:1.4: Mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana, bhikkhave, vuṭṭhite tena gāmāpi ḍayhanti nigamāpi ḍayhanti nagarāpi ḍayhanti.
segments.an3.62:1.5: Gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.
segments.an3.62:1.6: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ mahāmegho vuṭṭhāti.
segments.an3.62:2.2: Mahāmeghe kho pana, bhikkhave, vuṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati.
segments.an3.62:2.3: Mahāudakavāhake kho pana, bhikkhave, sañjāyante tena gāmāpi vuyhanti nigamāpi vuyhanti nagarāpi vuyhanti.
segments.an3.62:2.4: Gāmesupi vuyhamānesu nigamesupi vuyhamānesu nagaresupi vuyhamānesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.
segments.an3.62:2.5: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamāruḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
segments.an3.62:3.2: Bhaye kho pana, bhikkhave, sati aṭavisaṅkope cakkasamāruḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.
segments.an3.62:3.3: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:3.4: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:4.1: “Tāni kho panimāni [imāni kho (sī.), imāni kho pana (ka.)], bhikkhave, tīṇi samātāputtikāniyeva bhayāni amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:4.3: Hoti so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho vuṭṭhāti.
segments.an3.62:4.4: Mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana, bhikkhave, vuṭṭhite tena gāmāpi ḍayhanti nigamāpi ḍayhanti nagarāpi ḍayhanti.
segments.an3.62:4.5: Gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati.
segments.an3.62:4.6: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ samātāputtikaṃyeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ mahāmegho vuṭṭhāti.
segments.an3.62:5.2: Mahāmeghe kho pana, bhikkhave, vuṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati.
segments.an3.62:5.3: Mahāudakavāhake kho pana, bhikkhave, sañjāte tena gāmāpi vuyhanti nigamāpi vuyhanti nagarāpi vuyhanti.
segments.an3.62:5.4: Gāmesupi vuyhamānesu nigamesupi vuyhamānesu nagaresupi vuyhamānesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati.
segments.an3.62:5.5: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ samātāputtikaṃyeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamāruḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
segments.an3.62:6.2: Bhaye kho pana, bhikkhave, sati aṭavisaṅkope cakkasamāruḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati.
segments.an3.62:6.3: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ samātāputtikaṃyeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
segments.an3.62:6.4: “Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samātāputtikāniyeva bhayāni amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati”.
segments.an3.62:7.4: Na, bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ jīramānaṃ evaṃ labhati –
segments.an3.62:7.6: putto vā pana mātaraṃ jīramānaṃ na evaṃ labhati –
segments.an3.62:8.1: “Na, bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ byādhiyamānaṃ evaṃ labhati –
segments.an3.62:8.3: putto vā pana mātaraṃ byādhiyamānaṃ na evaṃ labhati –
segments.an3.62:9.1: “Na, bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ mīyamānaṃ evaṃ labhati –
segments.an3.62:9.3: putto vā pana mātaraṃ mīyamānaṃ na evaṃ labhati –
segments.an3.62:9.5: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi amātāputtikāni bhayānī”ti.
segments.an3.62:10.1: “Atthi, bhikkhave, maggo atthi paṭipadā imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya saṃvattati.
segments.an3.62:10.2: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, maggo katamā ca paṭipadā imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya saṃvattati?
segments.an3.62:10.4: sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkapo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi.
segments.an3.62:10.5: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya saṃvattatī”ti.

lines: Dutiye amātāputtikānīti mātā ca putto ca mātāputtaṃ, parittātuṃ samatthabhāvena natthi ettha mātāputtanti amātāputtikāni.
Tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhatīti tasmiṃ aggibhaye uppanne mātāpi puttaṃ passituṃ na labhati, puttopi mātaraṃ passituṃ na labhatīti attho.
Yadā hi te aṭavito janapadaṃ otaritvā gāmanigamarājadhāniyo paharitvā vilumpanti, tadā aṭavisaṅkopo nāma hoti, taṃ sandhāyetaṃ vuttaṃ.
Bhayasmiṃ hi sampatte yesaṃ yānakāni atthi, te attano parikkhārabhaṇḍaṃ tesu āropetvā palāyanti.
Yesaṃ natthi, te kājena vā ādāya sīsena vā ukkhipitvā palāyantiyeva.
Mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhatīti āgacchantaṃ vā gacchantaṃ vā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne nilīnaṃ vā passituṃ labhati.
Mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhatīti kulle vā uḷumpe vā mattikābhājane vā dārukkhaṇḍe vā laggaṃ vuyhamānaṃ passituṃ paṭilabhati, sotthinā vā puna uttaritvā gāme vā araññe vā ṭhitaṃ passituṃ labhatīti.
Evaṃ pariyāyato amātāputtikāni bhayāni dassetvā idāni nippariyāyena dassento tīṇimānītiādimāha.
“jaraṃ paṭicca uppajjati bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso utrāso.
Byādhiṃ paṭicca, maraṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso utrāso”ti (vibha.921).
Natthi ettha mātāputtaṃ aññamaññaṃ tāyituṃ samatthanti amātāputtāni, tāniyeva amātāputtikāni.
Mātāpi puttaṃ passituṃ na labhati, parittātuṃ na samatthanti adhippāyo.
Aṭaviggahaṇena aṭavivāsino vuttā “sabbo gāmo āgato”tiādīsu viyāti āha “aṭavīti cettha aṭavivāsino corā veditabbā”ti.
Ṭhānagamanādiiriyāpathacakkasamaṅgino iriyāpathacakkasamāruḷhā nāma hontīti āha “iriyāpathacakkampi vaṭṭatī”ti.
Ekasmiṃ ṭhāne nilīnanti vuttanayeneva gantvā ekasmiṃ kheme padese nisinnaṃ.
Kulle vātiādīsu kūlaṃ paratīraṃ vahati pāpetīhi kullo, taraṇatthāya veḷunaḷādīhi kalāpaṃ katvā baddho.
